config.scope: EuroSAT four-band replication of configs/compression_curve.json with identical rules (see that file for policies, outcome and questions). Run after the CIFAR curve. Official EuroSAT test split held out. Follow-up refinement at 0.375 and 0.625 only; keep all parent policies, seeds, data, fit rules, ridge alpha and training budgets. Separate outputs preserve the original run. The fraction-index random-stream convention is unchanged; repetitions across old/new fractions need not be independent.

followup.selection_disclosure: These two levels were selected after inspecting the coarse-grid results. Settings are registered before any outcomes at the added levels. This is an exploratory refinement using the same trained models and splits, not independent replication.
